node.title: Can Ecosystem Awareness Work?
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: From compressed agent outputs to qualified context: scientific plausibility and requirements alignment · 1. The architectural concern—and the opportunity it creates · 1.1 A useful answer can conceal the conditions that make it useful.
